class.name: OcgAISPoint
class.brief_description: Constructs point datums to be used in construction of composite shapes. The datum is displayed as the plus marker +.
class.description: ! Constructs point datums to be used in construction of ! composite shapes. The datum is displayed as the plus marker +.

method.name: Type
method.description: Indicates that a point is a datum.

method.name: Component
method.description: Returns the component specified in SetComponent.

method.name: SetComponent
method.description: Constructs an instance of the point aComponent.

method.name: AcceptDisplayMode
method.description: Returns true if the display mode selected is valid for point datums.

method.name: SetColor
method.description: Allows you to provide settings for the Color.

method.name: UnsetColor
method.description: Allows you to remove color settings.

method.name: SetMarker
method.description: Allows you to provide settings for a marker. These include - type of marker, - marker color, - scale factor.

method.name: Vertex
method.description: Converts a point into a vertex.
